biggest_catch: Your friend has to deposit and hold at least $10,000 for a full year - and you earn nothing if they withdraw below $10,000 or live at your address.
catches: The friend must make a net deposit of at least $10,000 within 30 days and maintain a remaining net deposit of $10,000+ through the vesting date (one year); withdrawals below $10,000 wipe out both bonuses.
Referrers are paid $200 per eligible referral, capped at 15 per calendar year and 30 total ($3,000/year max).
No bonuses/payments when referrer and referee are family members or live at the same address.
Tax-advantaged (IRA) accounts, entity accounts, financial advisors, Firstrade employees, and residents of China, HK, Macau, Spain, Portugal, Japan, Denmark, Israel, Poland are excluded.
Firstrade may change or close the program at any time at its sole discretion (terms dated FT08.2026 - August 2026).
Referrers may not help set up the friend's account, train them, or act as their financial contact/advisor - referral ends at the invitation.

steps: Be an existing Firstrade account holder (in good standing, not in an excluded country) and get your personal referral link from your Firstrade account.
Share your referral link with a friend who is new to Firstrade (not a prior account holder; not family or living at your address; non-IRA account).
Your friend opens a new Firstrade brokerage account via your link and makes a net deposit of at least $10,000 in cash or transferred assets within 30 days of account approval.

You receive a $200 flat-fee payment on the first business day after the vesting date (about 1 year later), provided the friend maintained $10,000+ in the account and both accounts are open and in good standing (max 15 per calendar year, 30 total).
timing: Payment issued on the first business day after the vesting date (about 1 year after the funding period), once the friend's bonus is earned.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Payment issued on the first business day after the vesting date (about 1 year after the funding period), once the friend's bonus is earned. — structural: the bonus requires a 12-month funding/balance hold before it is even earned.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 12-month hold is structural — this route cannot pay fast under any reading of the terms.
Volume constraint noted in terms: capped at 15 per calendar year and 30 total ($3,000/year max) — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
